title: Make exact catalog counts opt-in for ls
outcome: The ambient next and held-items paths currently execute an unbounded filtered COUNT on each catalog page although they discard total. Keep those paths bounded while ls retains exact count and page consistency.
acceptance: A regression proves next and held-items issue no total-count query while ls still reports exact filtered totals; the catalog and scale tests pass.

completion.summary: Exact counts are confined to query_work_catalog_listing, the ls receipt path. Ordinary query_work_catalog returns only a bounded page; the focused next-with-held-work counter regression records zero count queries, while ls records one. Shared SQL filters preserve exact filtered totals.
